headline: EU Proposes Big Tech Levy and €200 Billion Spending Cuts in Budget Draft
summary: European Council President Antonio Costa unveiled a budget draft reducing planned spending by €204 billion and proposing a levy on digital multinational firms to finance the bloc's long-term framework.
why: The European Union's multi-year budget establishes funding priorities across member states, while digital taxes directly hit earnings of global tech giants.

impacts.name: Big Tech
impacts.why: The proposed European levy on major digital companies increases prospective corporate tax liabilities.
